Subject: Telemetry Ops Orbit: implementation checkpoints

Hi Amit — great to meet on the call last week. We're kicking off the 'Orbit' onboarding for ClearShore's telemetry implementation. Goal: get dashboards, tracing hooks, error taxonomy and alert routing in place for pilot service by Sept 15.

Proposed 3-phase plan:
- Phase 0 (this week): discovery + baseline instrumentation and log alignment
- Phase 1 (2 weeks): trace hook placement and dashboard wireframes
- Phase 2 (handoff): runbook, alert routing matrix and escalation tests

Ask:
1) Please confirm who will be our ClearShore implementer on-call during the pilot.
2) Share any existing dashboard queries or SLO definitions (or a link).

I'm attaching a lightweight checklist and a runbook template so we can iterate quickly.

On Tue, Aug 15, 2028 at 09:12 AM Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Amit — great to meet on the call last week. We're kicking off the 'Orbit' onboarding for ClearShore's telemetry implementation.

Thanks Jasmine — this looks good.

Quick answers:
- I (Amit) will be the primary ClearShore implementer and our SRE, Priya Kaur, will be the escalation contact (priya.kaur@clearshore.com).
- We're currently running Grafana dashboards; I'll share the JSON exports after I pull them. Our primary SLO is p95 latency < 300ms and error budget 0.5%/day for the pilot API.

Can we schedule a 30-min alignment tomorrow to review the trace hook list and the dashboard wireframe? Prefer mornings PST.

Amit
Sr. Platform Engineer | ClearShore Health

Thanks Amit — adding here from the Implementation team.

Short update and proposed artifacts for the call:
- I've filled the runbook-template.md with an initial incident flow and three operating runbooks we should validate: "API 5xx spike", "KV cache blowup", "Slow tail latency".
- Tracing hooks: start with the public API + backend fanout points (auth, router, model-inference). We'll send a prioritized list in the shared Drive doc.
- Dashboards: attach a quick wireframe (dashboard-wireframe.png) that maps the p95/p99 panels to the new traces.
- Error taxonomy: propose grouping by user-visible errors (4xx), transient infra (timeout/retry), and model-related (tokenization/response errors). This will drive routing.

Action items for the meeting:
- Amit: confirm which Grafana data sources we can read from the Redwood side (read-only).
- Priya (ClearShore SRE): confirm on-call window and escalation steps.
- Ben: will own alert routing and SLO delta proposals.

Looping in alerting specifics. Short notes:
- Routing: primary alerts to ClearShore on-call (PagerDuty) with a Redwood shadow channel for the pilot. Escalation: 0-15m ack to ClearShore, 15-60m Redwood joins bridge if unacknowledged.
- Suggested alert thresholds (pilot):
  * API error rate: >0.8% sustained for 5m -> P2
  * p99 latency > 800ms for 10m -> P2
  * Model invocation failure rate >1% per 10m -> P1

I'll draft the alert-routing matrix and link it into the runbook. Also recommend a simple automation: route degraded model errors to the model-dev Slack channel (for triage) and infra timeouts to ops.

Ben Carter
SRE | Redwood Inference
